reason: The machine-quiet rule of E3b.S2, registered with the bare pre-registration. A phase is REFUSED when the machine is loaded (waiting is free before a phase; a pair started under foreign load is a paid, confounded data point) and load DURING a phase is only flagged (killing on load would make a void parent 11.1 does not list). Thresholds are CPU-equivalents of the 14-CPU host; the harness's own ticks are not foreign load.
